fields.description: Only users with this role see Phriend. Leave empty for everyone.
fields.label: Allowed Role

fields.description: Who gets the ToDo for each report. Empty = the person who reported it.
fields.label: Assign Reports To

fields.description: Set on every new Phriend Issue.
fields.label: Default Project

fields.description: Reports made on this system belong to this Implementation unless the page they were made on belongs to another one. It is how the Implementation Cockpit finds them.
fields.label: Implementation of this System

fields.description: Opens Phriend. Mod is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere, e.g. Mod+P or Mod+Shift+K. Empty: no shortcut. Each user can change or switch off their own in Phriend.
fields.label: Keyboard Shortcut

fields.description: One switch per Phriend feature. A feature that is off shows nowhere.
fields.label: Features

fields.description: Emoji hands next to the speech bubbles, and short reactions without words (thanks, high five, heart, ‼️).
fields.label: Hands and Reactions

fields.description: Empty: the URL from GitLab Settings is used.
fields.label: GitLab URL

fields.description: Project path (e.g. phamos/phamos) or numeric ID
fields.label: Default GitLab Project

fields.description: Token with the api scope (Reporter role). Empty: the token from GitLab Settings is used.
fields.label: GitLab Token

fields.description: Set this on a develop or test system: its Phriend reports become Issues on the target system, not here. Empty: reports stay on this system.
fields.label: Target System

fields.description: How the target's Issues name this system. Empty: the site name.
fields.label: This System's Name

fields.description: API key of a user with the role Phriend Remote on the target system
fields.label: Target API Key
